title: Normalized data of a finite adic realization cocone
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a Noetherian finite-dimensional scheme $T$ with $\ell$ invertible in every stalk, and $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$. Use the finite coefficient fields and raw rationalized integral constructible categories of [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients, def-weil-rationalization-karoubi], and continuous ordinary and internal module sheaves of [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-pbc-internal-abelian-sheaf-module-equivalence]. Define finiteFreeTarget and internalFiniteFreeTarget to mean bounded complexes whose cohomology is pro-etale locally finite free on some finite locally closed stratification. Core consists of the raw stage identity comparisons, their completion-normalized scalar family, normalized RationalModuleRealization data at every finite field, bijectivity on Hom sets and the finiteFreeTarget essential image. ScalarData consists of normalized continuous coefficient comparisons, theta for the actual literal-identity PBC transitions, the completed coefficient square, and the integral commuting diagram obtained by appending both single-derived-tensor flattenings and the published pbcScalarIntegralComparison. Coherence imposes the actual finite tower equation and normalized multiplication unit. ClosureData consists of section-ring legs into the pullback of finite-subextension-valued continuous Omega functions, normalized finite coefficient isomorphisms, pointwise formulas and the coefficient cocone equations. finiteFunctor, scalarComparison and closureComparison are their specified compositions. Data additionally imposes the four constructibility predicates and closure tower and identity equations. These are data structures and constructions, without an existence assertion. The integral diagram is packaged as the irreducible predicate integralNormalization, with its full displayed equality as its definition; scalarComparison, sectionDerived and closureComparison are irreducible constructions to prevent repeated expansion in generated structure declarations.
